Why Santana's

Puerto Rican street food, made for the street

Puerto Rican street food is bold and built for eating on the go — fried plantain, grilled skewers and golden pastries, full of garlic, herbs and crunch.

The menu stays short and focused on four favourites: mofongo, pinchos, empanadas and tostones. Fried, grilled and golden — made for eating on the go.
